notes.title: PERSEPHONE UI Update and Minor Adjustments
notes.notes:
[b][u]All changes made:
[/u][/b]

- Moved some of the error spawn points so none of them would clip inside of any objects

- Added UI for sprinting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157563/1c38b3af06643ee767db37ca0cb93f2cb44acf1f.png[/img]

- Indication for uploading is more pronounced (both in the inventory screen and when interacting with the I/O tower)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157563/d62c63b4f477fdff2d89e0d0d9f878e97b77c3d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157563/a35db036541876abd895dc3fba283d7f16bafe19.png[/img]

- Increased height of the static particles so they wouldn't phase through the ground (also fixed when it teleports behind the player)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157563/cc65ea90365115889ecf7a1e28146a5e4488d176.png[/img]

[b]Enjoy the changes and have fun![/b]

-Kyvati Studios

notes.title: Hard Mode Minor Fix
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue where the glitched bodies didn't speed up

notes.title: Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
[i]Added difficulty levels for the daring operators. Good luck.[/i]

[b]Added difficulties: [/b]

[i][b]Hard[/b][/i] (More damage is done to the player on all levels, no change to speed)

[i][b]Nightmare[/b][/i] (More damage is done to the player and entity speed is increased on all levels)

notes.title: Company Manual Distribution
notes.notes:
As per the title, in the next update there is a PDF in the root directory. 

It should give adequate guidance on the handling of the simulated environment of PERSEPHONE.

-R.J
